newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian, Dutch companies in reclamation pact.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian, Dutch companies in reclamation pact.

text.p: - A Malaysian company and a Dutch engineering concern signed a non-binding agreement to reclaim 800 acres (364 hectares) of land in southern Malaysia, the national Bernama news agency said on Wednesday.

The signing ceremony in the Netherlands, between Enerwise Sdn Bhd and Dutch engineering company Grabrowsky & Poort BV, was witnessed by Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, who is on a four-day official visit to Holland.
The project will have a development price tag of 800 million ringgit, with the overall project valued at around 1.2- to 1.4 billion ringgit, Bernama said
Grabrowsky has designed and constructed several large buildings in Holland, the news agency said.
